name: 1000 W0RDS
source: 1000 Words tells the story of a little girl whose family is falling apart. One day she meets an artist, and asks him to teach her how to draw better. He answers that she just has to train everyday, and a few years later she'll get better. But that's too slow to her; there's no time.
translation: 《1000 W0RDS》讲述了一个小女孩的故事，她的家庭正分崩离析。一天，她遇见一名画家，请求对方教自己把画画得更好。画家告诉她，只要每天练习，几年后自然会进步。可这对她来说太慢了——她已经没有时间。
